title: SWF: FrameLabel tag encoding
description: Compile frames with a non-empty label to emit FrameLabel (tag 43) before ShowFrame. Check compile.ts — currently labels may be skipped. Add FrameLabel emission in the frame loop for frames where frame.label is non-empty and frame.isKeyframe is true. Add unit tests in packages/swf/src/__tests__/framelabel.test.ts.
